run_consolidated_test_report: run the consolidated test report script to parse pytest stats files and generate a markdown report from a reports directory
parse_stats_file: parse a pytest stats text file to extract test counts, pass/fail/skip numbers, and slowest test durations
consolidate_reports: consolidate test reports from multiple pytest runs across subdirectories into aggregated statistics with slowest tests and failures
generate_report: generate a comprehensive markdown report with summary tables, test suite breakdowns, slowest tests, and failure details
create_slack_payload: create a Slack message payload with test summary, suite success rates table, and GitHub action link for nightly CI results
